scientific_integrity: The dispersive premise follows exactly from monotonicity of the quantile-function difference. Expectile levels and gaps are derived by exact integration and rational algebra, with one quadratic irrational and an integer square certificate. Finite computation only replays these identities.
scientific_limitations: The result is an explicit counterexample, not a characterization. The distributions have positive piecewise-constant densities rather than smooth densities. The phrase strong expectile-dispersive order refers specifically to the all-level Definition 7(iii) of Eberl and Klar; a later paper uses ex-dispersive for the weaker median-straddling order.
title: A continuous counterexample to dispersive order implying strong expectile-dispersive order
